description: Generate a personalized adult weight-management plan and render it as a standalone interactive HTML page with phased goals, nutrition and exercise guidance, meal photo analysis, and a local weight tracker.

display.description_en: Generate a personalized adult weight-management plan and render it as a standalone interactive HTML page with phased goals, nutrition and exercise guidance, meal photo analysis, and a local weight tracker.
display.description_zh: 生成个性化成人体重管理方案，渲染为可打卡的独立 HTML 页面：分阶段目标、饮食运动建议、餐食照片热量分析、本地体重记录。
examples_en: Current weight 53 kg, target 50 kg, height 160 cm, 28 years old, female, sedentary. Create a weight management plan for me.
Male, 35, current weight 100 kg, goal 89 kg, height 180 cm, sedentary, smoker. Create a weight management plan for me.
Analyze this lunch photo's calories and include it in my weight management plan.
